pages.title: Spacetime Singularity
pages.text: All of relativity, from Lorentz transformations to the field equations and the stress-energy that sources them, squeezed into the one place where relativity itself predicts its own breakdown. Clocks near it disagree with each other, and straight lines bend toward it.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Relativity predicts singularities but cannot describe them. Feeding the Compressor every tensor and transformation I had derived, I let the theory collapse onto the exact point where it fails, and kept that point.
